name: samuel
description: Personal indie hacker workflow: spec-driven pipeline with living journal, autonomous conductor, git, and project management skills

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven pipeline for indie hacker projects
interface.longDescription: A GitHub-native delivery pipeline: work items are Issues carrying a human Brief and a self-contained Executor Plan. Runs research → spec → plan → analyze → implement → validate with forced human checkpoints and a living implementation journal, then opens a PR. Includes an autonomous conductor for headless runs and a wave coordinator that parallelizes issues from the native dependency graph.
defaultPrompt: Plan issue 42 and write its Executor Plan
Implement the current phase and update the journal
Validate the implementation against the acceptance criteria
